marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text:
Wind southeast 20 to 25 knots diminishing to south 10 to 15 late
Sunday morning then veering to west 15 early Sunday afternoon. Wind increasing
to west 25 Sunday evening. Scattered flurries Sunday afternoon and evening changing to
snow. Fog patches forming Sunday morning and dissipating Sunday
afternoon. Temperatures near minus 2. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text: Outside the ice edge seas 1 metre or less.<br/>
